text:
maria: Quick check — I sketched a minimal binding contract for the hosted/dedicated/private probe handshake. want eyes before i file an rfc follow-up

tj: please, short on time but curious about safety on eviction windows

dinesh: can you paste the sketch here? easier to comment inline

maria: sure — gist of it:
```
ProbeRequest {
  tenant_id: string
  route: string
  mode_hint: enum[HOSTED, DEDICATED, PRIVATE]  // best-effort routing hint
  cred_token: optional string // short-lived probe token, rv: 60s
  probe_id: string
}

ProbeResponse {
  accepted: bool
  backend_type: enum[POOL, SIDE_CAR, PRIVATE_AGENT]
  lease_ttl_seconds: int // how long caller should consider the binding valid
  telemetry_endpoint: optional string // for telemetry fanout if provided
  fallback_policy: optional enum[RETRY_ROUTE, QUEUE, FAIL_FAST]
}
```

maria: intent is probe is lightweight and returns a binding w/ ttl. callers must re-probe before ttl expires or treat as potential eviction

tj: a few concerns: 1) mode_hint must never be authoritative — routing policy should validate against tenancy/entitlements 2) telemetry_endpoint as plain string opens us to leakage

dinesh: what if we return a telemetry_ref instead of endpoint, and only the control plane resolves it after auth check? avoids exposing internal urls to clients

kevin: agree on telemetry_ref. also lease_ttl should be dependent on backend_type (shorter for sidecar) — propose we encode min/max in response: lease_ttl and lease_grace_seconds

maria: good call. updated sketch in-thread:
```
ProbeResponse {
  accepted: bool
  backend_type: enum[POOL, SIDE_CAR, PRIVATE_AGENT]
  lease_ttl_seconds: int
  lease_grace_seconds: int // window to tolerate gradual eviction/handshake races
  telemetry_ref: optional string // control-plane opaque handle
  fallback_policy: optional enum[RETRY_ROUTE, QUEUE, FAIL_FAST]
  signed_at: timestamp // server-signed to prevent tampering
  signature: string // base64 of hmac or jwk sig
}
```

tj: signed response + ttl/grace should help with racing eviction -> rebind flows. but w.r.t private deployments: we cannot assume control plane will always be reachable to resolve telemetry_ref
dinesh: true. for PRIVATE we should allow telemetry_ref to be resolvable via customer-managed sink. maybe add metadata: {resolver_hint: enum[CONTROLPLANE, CUSTOMER_SINK]}

maria: hmm that would be adding a small nested metadata map — agents.md told us minimal surface. alternative: telemetry_ref prefix like "cp:xxxx" vs "cs:yyyy" so it's still a string but self-describing

kevin: strings are fine as long as we document formats. ops will hate implicit parsing though. can we include a version field in the response and a single-line comment in the contract that parsers must not rely on string formats long term?

maria: added version and pinned signature alg. also: security — do we allow user-supplied cred_token for probe? or control-plane minted only?

dinesh: control-plane minted only, otherwise customers could craft long-lived bindings. we should issue short-lived probe tokens via the customer SDK after auth + entitlement check. SDK should rotate transparently

tj: operational note: telemetry endpoints/ref resolution must be rate-limited per-tenant. if a rogue client re-probes a lot this could create noise; need quotas in the probe path

maria: agreed — include an error code for rate_limited and a Retry-After header mimic in the response for programmatic backoff

kevin: can we also add a discovery field for allowed_fallback_backends: [POOL, QUEUE] so clients know what fallback to request; avoids blind failovers

dinesh: sounds reasonable. keep it small though. fallback hints are advisory

maria: final sketch now:
```
ProbeResponse v1 {
  accepted: bool
  backend_type: enum[POOL, SIDE_CAR, PRIVATE_AGENT]
  lease_ttl_seconds: int
  lease_grace_seconds: int
  telemetry_ref: optional string
  telemetry_ref_version: string
  fallback_policy: optional enum[RETRY_ROUTE, QUEUE, FAIL_FAST]
  allowed_fallback_backends: optional list[string] // advisory
  signed_at: timestamp
  signature: string
  version: "1"
  error_code: optional string // e.g., RATE_LIMITED, NOT_ENTITLED
  retry_after_seconds: optional int
}
```

maria: next steps: someone take this and convert to an RFC PR, add security appendix for probe token lifecycle + signature verification. i can draft if no one beats me to it

tj: i'll take ops bits (rate limits + quotas). will drop a short doc tomorrow

dinesh: i'll add a short note on private deployment resolution flows and SDK behavior

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-6723 for probe handshake rfc draft (assignee: maria) :ticket:

kevin: thanks. small follow-up: we should simulate a 3s network partition test in the integration harness to validate lease_grace semantics before we finalize defaults

maria: adding test item to the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
